def split_amount(total_cents: int, n: int) -> list[int]:
    """
    Split total_cents into n integer parts as evenly as possible.
    
    Uses the Bresenham-style distribution algorithm to spread the
    remainder evenly across all positions, ensuring the difference
    between any two parts is at most 1.
    """
    return [total_cents * (i + 1) // n - total_cents * i // n for i in range(n)]
